capabilities: View habits on a month calendar.
extras: Supports English and Tiếng Việt; works offline.
intentEvidence: Your notes stay yours. A habit is <folder>/Drink water.md with frontmatter — no database, no sync service.
motivation: Your notes stay yours. A habit is <folder>/Drink water.md with frontmatter — no database, no sync service.
problem: Traditional habit trackers often require proprietary databases or cloud syncing, which users may find restrictive or undesirable for local note-taking.
summary: PDL Habit is a Markdown-first habit tracker that allows users to track habits using plain notes, frontmatter, and provides insights and calendar views.
